quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): net sales JPY 5,110,171 million (+9.2% YoY), operating profit JPY 418,173 million (+30.4%; operating margin 8.2%, up 1.3 points), ordinary profit JPY 431,274 million (+39.3%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 369,508 million (+90.7%); pre-tax ROIC 14.7% (prior year 9.3%). Management attributes the growth to sharply higher demand for data-center products in information and communications, firm wire-harness demand in automotive and firm power cable and substation equipment demand in environment and energy. Segment sales / operating profit: Environment and Energy JPY 1,178,780 million (+9.0%) / JPY 90,615 million (+15.1%); Infocommunications JPY 326,632 million (+46.3%) / JPY 77,435 million (+288.6%); Automotive JPY 2,937,168 million (+7.4%) / JPY 179,700 million (+4.2%); Electronics JPY 409,096 million (+8.4%, on higher FPC demand from a major customer) / JPY 39,528 million (+34.9%); Industrial Materials and others JPY 388,413 million (+4.2%) / JPY 31,399 million (+52.5%). Operating-profit bridge from JPY 320,663 million: sales volume +JPY 115,000 million, lower prices and product mix -JPY 19,000 million, copper and material prices -JPY 10,000 million, profitability improvement +JPY 34,000 million, FX +JPY 7,000 million, tariffs -JPY 5,000 million, other -JPY 24,490 million. Extraordinary income included a JPY 79,154 million gain on sale of shares of affiliates, of which JPY 76,044 million came from transferring all Sumitomo Densetsu shares on March 24, 2026 (after Daiwa House Industry's tender offer for Sumitomo Densetsu). Wire harness external sales JPY 2,281,700 million. Sales by customer location: Japan JPY 1,901,169 million, China JPY 640,715 million, other Asia JPY 705,448 million, United States JPY 835,907 million, other Americas JPY 323,517 million, Europe and other JPY 703,415 million. No external customer accounts for 10% or more of net sales.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 5,110,171 million (+9.2%); operating profit JPY 418,173 million (+30.4%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Infocommunications segment, year to March 2026 (annual securities report): demand for optical wiring products, optical cable and optical devices for data centers rose on the expansion of the generative-AI market; segment sales JPY 326,632 million (+JPY 103,356 million, +46.3%), operating profit JPY 77,435 million (+JPY 57,509 million) helped by product mix and productivity, operating margin 23.7% (up 14.8 points); segment assets JPY 367,373 million (+JPY 82,751 million). Segment capex JPY 23,746 million (capacity increase and rationalisation of optical / electronic devices and optical fiber and cable); planned segment capex for the following year JPY 72,000 million (optical fiber and cable, optical wiring products, optical / electronic device manufacturing equipment). Management states that with data-center demand expected to expand further on the rapid spread of generative AI, it will expand production capacity for optical cable, optical wiring products such as optical connectors, optical devices and indium phosphide (InP) substrates, and develop new products for faster, lower-latency and lower-power data transmission; it will also continue to develop and sell ultra-low-loss optical fiber for submarine cables and multi-core fiber (which it says it was the world's first to mass-produce), high-efficiency wireless devices and access network equipment. Under Mid-Term Management Plan 2028 the Digital / AI field aims to raise its share of the North American hyper data center market with a wide range of high-performance products.
quarterly_data.figure: Infocommunications sales JPY 326,632 million (+46.3%); operating profit JPY 77,435 million; next-year capex plan JPY 72,000 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mid-Term Management Plan 2028 (the three fiscal years April 2026 to March 2029, FY2027 to FY2029; the company calls them fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2028; published May 2026), as stated in the annual securities report: focus fields Digital / AI, Energy and Mobility; JPY 1 trillion of cumulative capex over the three years; targets for the fiscal year ending March 2029 (FY2029; the company's fiscal 2028) of net sales JPY 6 trillion (about JPY 1 trillion more than results for the year ended March 2026), operating profit JPY 600 billion (up by about half on those results) and pre-tax ROIC of 15% or more. The previous plan (Mid-Term Management Plan 2025) targets of net sales JPY 4,400,000 million, operating profit JPY 250,000 million and pre-tax ROIC of 8% or more were all exceeded. Energy: expand cable manufacturing and installation capacity globally and grow orders as a 'local company'; start up a new power-cable base in Europe. Mobility: become a 'global mobility supplier' building on its top-class world share in wire harnesses. Management expects the business environment to stay uncertain, citing Middle East tension (logistics and supply-chain disruption, higher raw-material and energy prices on rising oil prices), the review of US trade policy and China's slowdown.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2029 (year ending March 2029) targets: net sales JPY 6 trillion; operating profit JPY 600 billion; pre-tax ROIC 15% or more; 3-year capex JPY 1 trillion

quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Environment and Energy segment (annual securities report): construction and plant orders received JPY 494,621 million (+JPY 1,973 million, +0.4%), order backlog at March 31, 2026 JPY 447,060 million. Segment sales rose on power cable, rectangular magnet wire for EV motors, Nissin Electric's substation equipment and Sumitomo Densetsu's electrical work. Management will pursue domestic replacement demand plus national / inter-regional interconnector and renewable-energy power-cable orders (developing extra-high-voltage DC cable, offshore wind cable and cable accessories), and raise substation equipment production capacity.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual securities report): group R&D expense JPY 162,858 million in the year to March 2026, of which Infocommunications JPY 22,233 million. Optical communications R&D covers ultra-low-loss glass, new thin-diameter and bend / lateral-pressure resistant fibers, multi-core fiber and next-generation hollow-core fiber; high-capacity, high-density optical wiring products for the large data centers being built worldwide as AI infrastructure, with the supply chain being strengthened for surging demand, and new technology for photonics-electronics convergence that combines higher computing performance with lower power. Devices: products for data-center equipment and coherent transmission devices for long-haul equipment; high-efficiency GaN transistors for mobile base stations (being improved for 5G and next generation). Compound semiconductor materials: new InP and GaAs epitaxial wafer products for high-speed optical devices and wireless devices. A new R&D building at Yokohama Works has been completed and is due to start operating, to accelerate development of optical connectors and optical connection parts for data centers.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 162,858 million; Infocommunications R&D JPY 22,233 million
